header.label: Comparison
header.title: OpenAEC vs Bluebeam
header.desc: Open PDF Studio is a free, open source alternative to Bluebeam Revu. Compare PDF annotation, measurement tools, redaction and collaboration — factual and balanced.

summary.p1: Bluebeam Revu has been the de facto industry standard for PDF markup in construction since 2002. The software offers advanced annotation, measurement and collaboration features and is deeply embedded in workflows at contractors, architects and engineering firms. Bluebeam Revu typically costs €300-500 per user per year (subscription), depending on edition (Basics, Core, Complete) and country.
summary.p2: Open PDF Studio from the OpenAEC Foundation is a free, open source PDF editor with its own Rust engine for fast vector PDF rendering. The project now has more than 15.858 downloads and offers 20+ annotation tools, measurement functions, redaction, OCR and forms. License: LGPL-3.0. No subscription, no telemetry, no vendor lock-in.
